description: This file defines the MediaFrameWriterV1 class, which implements the IMediaFrameWriter interface for writing media frames to shared memory. It includes class members, methods for writing frame data, and metadata handling, along with constants for versioning and encryption metadata size.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterV1
classes.description: A class responsible for writing media frames and associated metadata to shared memory, implementing the IMediaFrameWriter interface.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1
methods.description: Constructor initializing the writer with shared memory buffer and info.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment frame to shared memory.

methods.name: getNumFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames written so far.

methods.name: writeMetaDataGeneric
methods.description: Writes generic metadata for a media segment.

methods.name: writeMetaDataTypeSpecific
methods.description: Writes type-specific metadata for a media segment.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes media segment data to shared memory.
